summary.en-US: Read web pages aloud with a voice model running on your own machine: floating player, sentence highlighting, many voices, MP3 export. Needs the free local server from the project page.

description.en-US:
VibeVoice Reader reads the article on a page, a selection, or any block you click on, highlighting the sentence being spoken. Voices and models are switchable while reading, speed changes keep the pitch, and pages or sentence ranges can be exported as MP3 or WAV.

Audio is generated by a small local server (open source, same project) that runs Microsoft's VibeVoice models, Kokoro, Qwen3-TTS or MOSS-TTS on your computer. Nothing leaves your machine. Without the server the extension only shows "server unreachable".

This project is not affiliated with Microsoft; VibeVoice is the name of their open model family.

version.approval_notes: This extension is a client for a local text-to-speech server (same repository, MIT). Reviewers without the server will see the player report the server as unreachable; the source archive contains both parts and the README has the build steps. The bundle in dist/ is produced by esbuild from extension/src.
